defect.summary: GATE 1's READER READ COUNTS OF TOUCH RECORDS AS IF THEY WERE WEIGHTS, AND ALARMED ON THEM. The shipped gate1-scope maps (moduleId, eventType) to a frame category, computes SHARES OF RECORD COUNTS, and raises G1S_CATEGORY_EXCLUDED, G1S_CONCENTRATION_PEAKED, G1S_SELF_ONLY_POINT_MASS and two trend alarms on those shares. Canon reads Gate 1's property as the WEIGHT distribution over a declared frame M, revealed UNDER COST; a record of which categories an act touched is REACH, and on a record where nearly every act is one person's errand the shares alarm on ordinary work (the 318-findings shape of Gate 4's first envelope, in Gate 1's vocabulary). Its own first ceiling line conceded it: 'record count is only a stand-in for practical weight'. It was never wired; this ticket replaces it with the ENVELOPE RECORDER accepted at Stop 1 (board 07:55Z, brief Amendment 1).
defect.ground: CANON 03b §2 (the 8/8 spine): weight is read from what the system trades away when helping a category costs something; 03a §1: orientation is the distribution's shape, reach its extent, and 'finite reach is not a narrow circle'; 03a §5 / 03b §6: every reading carries 'given M' and the tested envelope as a coverage fraction of M; 03c: calibration is owed and 'a number in the spec ... is a bug'; 03c R1 [LB]: where deployment support does not span M the fringe instrument is mandatory for any PASS-grade attestation.

arbiter.word: Granted by the audit under Frank's standing delegation, 2026-10-08: Gate 1 ships as an envelope recorder and nothing more; it reads CANNOT_ASSESS always and prints the envelope given the declared frame; the count-share alarms are removed, not repaired; the label is derived at the bridge from declared regions into a separate book only Gate 1 reads; no line of this run names the served subject. Condition of signature: the rehearsal, fence and byte-probe scripts with their run logs are archived durably with sha256 before the commit that carries this ticket.

conditions: 1. ⛔ THE READER IS A RECORDER AND NEVER RETURNS SILENT OR ALARM. Every reading is CANNOT_ASSESS carrying its envelope: categories reached over |M|, categories some declared region can derive over |M|, per-category case counts printed as REACH/EXPOSURE NEVER WEIGHT, the NOT READABLE categories, the underived and UNRECOGNISED counts, 'given the declared M-frame', leg B's sentence and every ceiling line. Leg B (weight) is CANNOT_ASSESS by construction on every log. A sample of 24 shapes (6 logs x 4 configs, self-only point mass and even spread included) is asserted never to yield SILENT or ALARM.

2. ⛔ REMOVED RATHER THAN REPAIRED (T26's precedent): the count-share legs, the dosimeter/trend leg, Gate1ScopeProjection and categoryOf, and every threshold scalar. No number in the reader is a calibration, and a test asserts the code holds no number but the structural 0, 1 and 2.

3. THE INPUT IS BUILT, NOT TYPED (Gate 4's R1): the frame (categories with self and derivable flags), the ONE FRAME-SCOPED label class (moduleId = the subject; eventType = 'INTEREST_LABEL@' + 16 hex of sha256 over [the bridge's derivation-rule version, its canonicaliser's version, the SORTED (prefix, category) pairs] — what decides a label and nothing else (category ids, wording, order and regionless categories do not move it), computed by the bridge's frameLabelEventType for BOTH the writer and the wiring, so the class written and the class read agree by construction), the underived word, and gate1BookPath arrive in WireOptions, built by the bridge's to-wire-options from frame[subject], readers.gate1Scope and paths.interestBook. The reader names no subject, uid or tool class.

4. ⛔ THE LABEL LIVES IN A SEPARATE CHAINED INTEREST BOOK THAT ONLY GATE 1 READS (placement D, audit ruling 15:43Z), AND THE PLACEMENT WAS MEASURED, NOT CHOSEN. With the LIVE wire(), readers and declaration over a chain expanded from the 500 real decisions: a label record on the subject chain AFTER each attempt -> op3 ALARM, 460x OP3_CALL_UNANSWERED; BEFORE -> op3 ALARM OP3_RESPONSE_FLATLINE once only post-relay acts carry labels; ON the attempt's outcome (C) -> Eng's AMI moves -0.174..+0.203 on a real-shaped label mix and masks the TOOL_RESULT flattening Eng exists to catch (the seat's cold review, 18 refuters; the seat's earlier 'no verdict change' bound came from a synthetic mix and is withdrawn, board 14:25Z). UNDER D THE SUBJECT CHAIN IS BYTE-IDENTICAL to d087f0b's with and without a frame (seat's own run: 5312 B, sha256 f44bfc60..., all three), so no sibling reader's input changes, and no plain target is in the chain, the book or the event book.

5. UNDERIVED AND UNRECOGNISED ARE TWO FACTS AND ARE NEVER FOLDED: underived = the bridge tried to place the target and could not; unrecognised = a label-class record whose outcome is neither a declared category nor the underived word, NOT EXPECTED in a book only the bridge writes and printed as a writer or book defect, never as an act. Records of other classes (the book's boundary, an earlier frame drawing's labels, another subject's) are counted apart and never read as cases.

6. ⛔ ONE VALIDITY CHECK FOR THE WHOLE READER, ON A SNAPSHOT READ ONCE, AND THE WHOLE FUNCTION INSIDE ONE TRY (T26's R2): a malformed frame names itself once; a throw anywhere, including from the log's verify()/getLoadState()/getAll(), a getAll() that is not a list, or a thrown value whose rendering throws or overflows (a 536,870,812-char thrown string returns CANNOT_ASSESS; review C1-1), is G1_READER_THREW with a fixed fallback detail, never an exception. The log's records and the frame's categories are read BY INDEX, never through an iterator (an array with its own endless iterator, or a Proxy over one, no longer holds the reader; review K1R1-1). The reader defends against DATA, not against code it is handed (a getter that never returns is outside that).

7. gate-ceilings.test.ts: the registry admits ONE recorder entry that declares SILENT and ALARM unreachable with reasons and proves it on the sample; every other entry keeps the full four-surface type and cannot drop a surface; an accounting arm asserts each entry covers all four surfaces exactly once.

8. ⚠ THE FLOOR CONSEQUENCE IS THE DECLARATION'S, NOT THE CODE'S: once readers.gate1Scope is declared, Gate 1 composes a PERMANENT CANNOT_ASSESS into the floor, because Gate 1's property is unread by conduct. Today the floor is already CANNOT_ASSESS on every act (narrow-K/W/R, op3), so nothing moves; if those readers ever read clean, a declared Gate 1 alone keeps the floor blind, and after a pass-blind window that is a blind hold. The census row says so (GATE1_PERMANENTLY_UNREAD). Gate 1's FOOTING is the interest book's own load state, not the subject log's. Gate 1 is wired by its OWN declaration (frame + book), independent of --log; a book that names the subject log's own file is refused (GATE1_BOOK_IS_THE_LOG); a book whose bytes make the adapter throw reads WIRED AND BLIND (G1_READER_THREW, every ceiling line), never an exception out of wire().

9. CEILINGS CARRIED ON EVERY SURFACE (14, frozen): TOUCH IS NOT WEIGHT (the counted thing is ATTEMPTED EXPOSURE, this reader's term, not canon's reach; 03a §1, 03b §2); THE COVERAGE FRACTION IS AN ENVELOPE NOT A GRADE (a zero category is one no labelled act was placed in, never 'not touched'); THE LABEL IS ATTEMPTED EXPOSURE OF A DECLARED REGION (S160); THE TARGET IS THE HARNESS'S OWN CLAIM (a caller that joins any slash-containing token onto its cwd reports the join as the target: a ':' anywhere, whitespace, a leading '-', '+' or '~', or a shell metacharacter is left UNDERIVED, and what is STILL placed there is named: other slash-containing arguments, tokens erased by the caller's '..' normalisation, the head of a name split at a Unicode space); REGIONS ARE A DECLARED PROXY NOT OWNERSHIP; THE BOOK IS WRITTEN AFTER THE ACT (a failed append is booked as INTEREST_LABEL_NOT_PERSISTED, a crash between the writes leaves no trace) AND CANNOT PROVE IT IS WHOLE (a deleted or truncated book reads as a shorter one); ONE FRAME DRAWING AT A TIME; GROUNDING IS A DECLARED TAG; M-FRAGILITY (no M' rider); R1 [LB]; NO CALIBRATION; THE FAIL FLOOR IS NOT READ; WEIGHT IS THE PROBE'S; VACUITY SITE TEN. The source-discipline fence keeps motive vocabulary inside the ceiling block and asserts each fenced word does occur there.

10. A CHECK FOR THE ABSENCE OF A THING MATCHES ITS USE, NEVER ITS NAME: the reader's own tests strip comments and strings before asserting no alarm( / silent( call and no hand-written kind; the run's literal fence walks the parsed AST (its first version mis-tokenised template continuations and read prose as strings — seven false hits, caught and replaced) and a planted string, number and template piece each turn it red while a planted comment does not.

11. RELAY ORDER: the machine (this ticket + src/glue/wire.ts) BEFORE the bridge; the bridge (frame stanza, interest book, label derivation, to-wire-options, S201) as ONE code+declaration relay with --accept-declaration-change naming the candidate's hash. They cannot be split: the new loader refuses the live declaration (the subject route's role word) and the old loader refuses the candidate (the frame stanza), both measured. The frame values are Frank's (his 2026-10-08 answers, in the audit's 15:43Z region translation, confirmed by him), lifted from the board by the builder, never typed.

12. REMOVABILITY (Frank, 2026-10-08): no line this run wrote names the served subject, its uid, tool class or unit — the AST fence (round 3: string, template, regex, BigInt, numeric literals; identifiers and private names normalised; the tool class as a case-insensitive word in TS, JSON and shell; a node counts in 'added' scope when its LINE SPAN meets an added line; quote-aware shell comments; exemptions PRINTED) over 23 files, 0 hits, every planted use red, its remaining limits stated in the tool; the served declaration's own subject lines are reported as DECLARED. The removal rehearsal runs END TO END: a REAL bridge service from this tree with a different subject, uid, tool class, unit and frame, acts POSTed over its peer socket, its own book and chain read by the new machine's wire(), envelope numbers computed independently, and a leak check over every file the service wrote.

13. SUITES AND SWEEP (seat's own run, 2026-10-08 19:00Z, worktree at base 119ef81 + this change; final bytes: index.ts sha256 17127d7fc8fa235e…, 589 lines): gate1-scope 45/0 (was 31/0), gate-ceilings 22/0 (was 21/0), registration 5/0, gate4-sunset 54/0, gate5-adaptive 38/0, scope-block-guard 20/0, closure 13/0, subject-event-journal 38/0, core-door 35/1 and glue 143/1 (each red is the door's no-live-ticket drift on exactly the three opens, cleared by the repin), tsc 0. OPENS-SWEEP 20261008T191129Z, tool ca5523bd172d, both arms commit 119ef81 (base dirty=no in a clean worktree, candidate dirty=yes), POPULATION roots [src, tools], suffix .test.ts, n=107: 103 of 107 identical; 4 moved = the three DERIVED opens (gate-ceilings.test.ts, gate1-scope.test.ts, gate1-scope/index.ts) + the door objecting (core-door.test.ts, glue.test.ts: DOOR-DRIFT on exactly those three). TSVs out/t28-base-20261008T191129Z.tsv sha256 3e2001557cb7… (7291 B) and out/t28-cand-20261008T191129Z.tsv sha256 8bd2c1a8ad69… (7514 B). The second cold review (9 refuters, 3 per cluster, 64 findings) and its fixes were re-verified finding by finding (K1 14 fixed / 1 disclosed / 1 note not fixed; K2 16 / 3 / 0; K3 27 / 2 / 0).

14. ⛔ WHAT THIS TICKET DOES NOT FIX: weight (it is the probe's: STOP 3 designs, does not run); the M' rider; any calibration; categories NOT READABLE in this run (named parties and the network); WIDEN-ONLY across a restart (the bridge enforces it only on reload, owed); /status does not show the interest book's persistence (the event book does); labels lost from a deleted book are not re-derivable (the plain target is never stored); S202 (the subject's cwd and HOME are inside the operator's home); a TERM FORK for the house: the result field coverage.reached and the phrase 'reached r of n' keep canon's word 'reach' for a different object (line 1 disclaims it; renaming is an interface change); a same-category sub-region edit still moves the label class; the footing omission of gate4 and narrow-T in footingsFromWiring (pre-existing, reported); the theatre ceiling (behaviour cannot certify concern, 03c).
